description: ARRAY_GENERATE_RANGE(start, stop [, step]) - start inclusive to stop exclusive, with a default step of 1, an explicit positive step, a negative step counting down, and a NULL input answering NULL. Converted 1:1 from functions/ArrayGenerateRangeTest (now retired); the array cells are read through TO_JSON so the assertion is on the array's JSON text rather than on a transport's own rendering of an ARRAY cell.
